claims.label: Host Says Erika Kirk Was Scheduled to Appear at UGA with VP JD Vance
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk was scheduled to appear alongside Vice President JD Vance at the University of Georgia event the night before.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via TPUSA event listing, UGA/Akins Ford Arena booking records, and contemporaneous press releases.

claims.label: UGA TPUSA Staff Uninformed of Erika's Absence
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA staff at the UGA event, including field representative Grant Tyler and chapter president Caroline in a video she plays, were still promoting Erika Kirk's appearance about 50 minutes before doors opened, which she says shows they had not been told she would not attend.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference social-media post timestamps against TPUSA internal communication records; obtain statements from named staff.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet Cited Security Threats as Reason for Erika's UGA No-Show
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Andrew Kolvet announces on stage at the UGA event that Erika Kirk is absent because she has received "very serious threats" in her direction.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain audio/video of the announcement; verify whether the announcement was scripted or extemporaneous.

claims.label: TPUSA Security Team Declined to Guarantee Erika's Safety
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated on Fox News that TPUSA's security team told the organization "we cannot guarantee your safety" regarding Erika Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Fox News segment; identify which TPUSA security contractor is referenced.

claims.label: Kolvet Retroactively Reclassified High School Cancellation as Security-Driven
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated on Charlie Kirk's show that the high school event, which the host says was cancelled on Monday, was also cancelled due to "increased online chatter" being monitored by TPUSA security.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against the originally issued parent-alert notice (A-1972.1); determine whether the explanation was issued contemporaneously or after public criticism.

claims.label: Daily Wire Reported Travel Doxing and Direct Threats
claims.claim: The Daily Wire reported, citing a TPUSA official, that Erika Kirk's travel itinerary was being doxed, that multiple direct threats were made, and that the chief security concern was the travel portion.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the named TPUSA official cited by Daily Wire; verify any law-enforcement reports referenced.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Stated Cancellation Followed Security Team Recommendation
claims.claim: Erika Kirk posted on X that she cancelled because she "takes [her] security team's recommendations extremely seriously."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain timestamp of post relative to the on-stage announcement; verify whether the post was authored by Kirk personally.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Stated She Feels Safe and Fears Nothing in Jesse Watters Interview
claims.claim: Erika Kirk stated on Jesse Watters that she does not feel threatened and that any attempt would simply send her "to heaven sooner."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm full interview date and air date; verify whether the clip presented is representative of the full exchange.

claims.label: Per Text Host Shows, Georgia High School Event Cancelled Monday Citing "Scheduling Complications"
claims.claim: Per a parent-alert text the host shows, TPUSA cancelled an optional high school event 'scheduled for tomorrow, September 14th' (as the host reads it), citing "scheduling complications" rather than security threats, according to the host.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original email/text from TPUSA to the school; interview named administrators.

claims.label: Per Facebook Chat Host Shows, Parents and Teachers Organizing Boycott of Erika Kirk at Pinnacle High School
claims.claim: Per a parental Facebook chat the host shows, a parent and an anonymous member who says they are a teacher object to Erika Kirk's appearance at Pinnacle High School in Phoenix, the teacher calling it 'a safety risk' and urging parents to call their kids out of school; the host says they are organizing essentially a walkout, a boycott.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm event status with Pinnacle High School administration; obtain school district statement.

claims.label: Georgia High School Cancellation Text References "September 14th"
claims.claim: Per the parent-alert text the host shows, the cancelled Georgia high school event was described as 'scheduled for tomorrow, September 14th', as the host reads it.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original email to determine whether "September" is a transcription/OCR artifact or a genuine content error.

claims.label: Akins Ford Arena Less Than 25% Filled for VP Event
claims.claim: MS Now reporter Jake Traylor reported that Akins Ford Arena was less than 25% filled for the Vice President's appearance.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with venue ticket-issuing records and TPUSA promotion metrics.

claims.label: Victor Marx Posted Video Response on Instagram/X
claims.claim: Victor Marx posted a short video response on Instagram and X to Candace Owens' prior episode, in which he says "Well, all righty then. Love you, Candace. Let me know when you want me to come on the show. Praying for you."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify post URL, timestamp, and whether the post has since been deleted or edited.

claims.label: Candace Owens Invited Victor Marx to Appear with Corby Hall
claims.claim: Candace Owens publicly replied beneath Marx's post inviting him to appear on her show together with Corby Hall; Hall reportedly agreed.
claims.investigative_direction: Capture timestamped screenshots of the comment thread before any deletion.

claims.label: Candace Owens DM'd Victor Marx Privately Requesting a Phone Number
claims.claim: Candace Owens sent a private DM to Victor Marx requesting his phone number to schedule a joint appearance; as of air no read receipt had been observed.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify DM timestamp; await Marx's response or non-response.

claims.label: Host Reads TPUSA Bio Identifying Marcus Wada as Director of Strategy of Productions
claims.claim: Per the Turning Point USA website bio the host reads, Marcus Wada is the "director of strategy of productions" at Turning Point USA.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain archived copies of the TPUSA bio page; verify against TPUSA staff directory and IRS Form 990 disclosures.

claims.label: Host Reads Marcus Wada TPUSA Bio Listing Miss Universe and TPUSA Documentaries
claims.claim: Per the Turning Point USA website bio the host reads, Marcus Wada has credits on Miss Universe and on the TPUSA documentary series "Border Battle" and "The Great Global Reset."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference against IMDb / production credits; verify production dates and roles.

claims.label: Host Says Marcus Wada's Brother's Consulting Firm Lists Trafficking Among Industry Areas
claims.claim: The host says the consulting firm run by the man she presumes is Marcus Wada's half brother, which she shows on its website, lists industry areas including human trafficking, sex trafficking, firearms and ammunition, money laundering, and controlled substances.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full webpage capture; identify the firm and confirm the family relationship through independent records.

claims.label: Erika Kirk's Public Stance Reversed from Fearlessness to Security-Based Cancellation
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Erika Kirk tells Jesse Watters she is not afraid; the host asks what changed, then plays a Fox News clip in which Andrew Kolvet says the security team told them it could not guarantee her safety and recommended against the UGA appearance.
claims.investigative_direction: Compile chronology of Kirk's public statements on personal safety; identify whether a specific triggering event is documented.

claims.label: Host Says Marcus Wada Reportedly Discusses Past Arms Trafficking in Poland
claims.claim: The host says unnamed current and former TPUSA employees told her that Marcus Wada openly discusses past involvement in arms trafficking in Poland and is very close to Andrew Kolvet; she says he allegedly trafficked arms.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify at least one named corroborating source; cross-reference LinkedIn history (A-1976.1) for prior Poland-based employment.

claims.label: TPUSA Public Explanation Sequence Internally Inconsistent
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA's explanation for Erika Kirk's UGA no-show kept changing, playing a clip from The Charlie Kirk Show in which Andrew Kolvet says a high school event was cancelled over online chatter, while the parent text she showed earlier cited scheduling complications.
claims.investigative_direction: Construct a chronological explanation map; identify the originator of each stated rationale and any superseding statements.

claims.label: JD Vance Defended Erika Kirk Against Criticism at UGA Event
claims.claim: Vice President JD Vance stated on stage at the UGA event that criticizing Erika Kirk over her grieving was "the most preposterous thing I've seen in a very long time" in politics.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full transcript of Vance's remarks; verify whether the statement was prepared or responsive to Andrew Kolvet's prompt.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Was at Home, Not in Georgia, When the Event Was Promoted
claims.claim: The host says that Erika Kirk was not on the ground in Georgia but back home, so the decision not to appear must have been made before the UGA staff posted their promotion video.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Erika Kirk's April 14, 2026 travel records or private-aviation flight data and the time the decision was communicated to TPUSA event staff.
claims.transcript_snippet: She was back home, which means that decision had to have already been made long before those students made that video.

claims.label: Kolvet Blamed Critics Who Make Part-Time Jobs of Attacking Erika
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Andrew Kolvet, on the UGA stage, tied the threats against Erika Kirk to attacks from people who have made part-time jobs out of attacking her.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full video of the UGA stage remarks and check who, if anyone, Kolvet named as the critics.
claims.transcript_snippet: Some of the people that have made you know part-time jobs out of attacking Erika and this is the net result.

claims.label: Host Says Vance Had Just Returned From Iran Negotiations
claims.claim: The host says Vice President JD Vance had just returned from negotiations with Iran overseas, so his Secret Service detail should have been capable of covering Erika Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Vice President's April 2026 public schedule and reporting on the Iran negotiations.
claims.transcript_snippet: he just got back doing negotiations with Iran overseas.

claims.label: Kolvet Cites Savanah Hernandez Minneapolis Incident and Says Cancellation Was a First for TPUSA
claims.claim: On Fox News, Andrew Kolvet said that cancelling Erika Kirk's appearance was, to his knowledge, the first time TPUSA has had to make such a decision, and pointed to what happened to TPUSA front-lines reporter Savanah Hernandez in Minneapolis.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Fox News segment and reporting on the Savanah Hernandez Minneapolis incident, and check TPUSA's history of cancelled appearances.
claims.transcript_snippet: which I think is the first time that we've ever had to make that decision in Turning Point history.

claims.label: Host Says Daily Wire Always Has the Inside Scoop on Erika Since the Assassination
claims.claim: The host says that since Charlie Kirk's passing the Daily Wire has always had the inside scoop on Erika Kirk, and that it carried the TPUSA official's threat explanation.
claims.investigative_direction: Compile Daily Wire reports sourced to TPUSA officials since September 2025 and identify the officials cited.
claims.transcript_snippet: since Charlie's passing, the Daily Wire, you will note, always has the inside scoop on what's going on with Erika Kirk for some reason.

claims.label: Host Says Erika's Plane Had Been Tracked From the Start Without Any Cancellation
claims.claim: The host says people had been tracking Erika Kirk's plane since the very beginning, doing entire shows on it, and that she never cancelled anything because of it.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect earlier plane-tracking coverage of Erika Kirk's travel and compare it with her cancelled appearances.
claims.transcript_snippet: People had been actually tracking Erika's plane since the very beginning. People were doing entire shows about where she was going and how much she was traveling and how ridiculous it was. And she never canled a single thing.

claims.label: Host Says the Arena Holds 7,000 People
claims.claim: The host says the Akins Ford Arena at the Classic Center near the University of Georgia holds just 7,000 people, against more than 43,000 enrolled UGA students.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the venue's published capacity and UGA enrollment figures.
claims.transcript_snippet: at the Classic Center, which is near the University of Georgia. The stadium holds just 7,000 people.

claims.label: Host Says Free Tickets Were Opened to the General Public
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA opened the free tickets for the UGA event to the general public, not only students.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the event registration page, ticket terms and registration counts.
claims.transcript_snippet: to make matters easier for them, they also opened the tickets, the free tickets to the general public.

claims.label: Host Says Ticket Numbers for the UGA Event Were Abysmal
claims.claim: The host says nobody wanted to attend the UGA event and that the ticket numbers were abysmal, which she gives as the real reason the appearance was cancelled.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the event's ticket registration totals and any internal TPUSA attendance projections.
claims.transcript_snippet: Reality, nobody wanted to attend. The ticket numbers were abysmal.

claims.label: Host Says Fox Segment Used B-Roll Spliced From Three Other Events
claims.claim: The host says the Fox News clip of Andrew Kolvet did not show the real Athens venue but B-roll from old Turning Point events, spliced together from three separate events.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the source events of the three spliced B-roll clips and obtain the original Fox broadcast.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Struggled to Move Tickets for Erika's Washington DC Event With Leavitt
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA college students and volunteers told her that TPUSA also had a very hard time moving tickets for Erika Kirk's Washington DC event with Karoline Leavitt.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the DC event's registration and attendance data and ask the volunteers' sources for corroboration.
claims.transcript_snippet: similarly had a very hard time uh moving tickets for her event in Washington DC with Karoline Leavitt.

claims.label: Host Says UGA Was the Worst Turnout in Turning Point History
claims.claim: The host says the UGA event looks to have been the worst audience turnout in Turning Point's history.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the UGA attendance estimate against TPUSA's other event turnout figures.
claims.transcript_snippet: And yesterday, it looks like was the worst audience turnout in Turning Point's history.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Moved the Believers Summit for Lack of Free Tickets Taken
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA had to move the Believers Summit it advertised last year for October because it could not move any free tickets.
claims.investigative_direction: Check TPUSA's Believers Summit announcements and date changes against registration reports.
claims.transcript_snippet: they had to move the believers summit, something that they advertised for last year.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Knew Long Before and Posted Only After the Event Began
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk knew she was not coming long before Andrew Kolvet's on-stage announcement, yet made no statement herself until after the event began.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the timestamp of Erika Kirk's X post with the start of the event and the stage announcement.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Was at Bettina Anderson's Mar-a-Lago Bridal Shower That Weekend
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk was at the White House over the weekend and at the Mar-a-Lago bridal shower of Bettina Anderson, who is marrying Donald Trump Jr., as evidence that she can show up when she wants to.
claims.investigative_direction: Check reporting and guest accounts of the bridal shower and Erika Kirk's White House visit that weekend.
claims.transcript_snippet: She was at Betina Betina at Mara Lago, the one who's marrying Don Trump Jr., she was at her bridal shower.

claims.label: Host Recounts Past Threat Handling With Charlie Kirk in Nashville
claims.claim: The host says that in a past case of a threat from a man who had escaped a mental institution, TPUSA alerted her and security while she was doing an event in Nashville with Charlie Kirk, and that nobody announced the threat publicly.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the Nashville event date and any police record of the escaped patient.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Told the High School on Monday at Noon, a Day Before the Stage Announcement
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk had informed the Georgia high school at noon on Monday that she would not attend, a full day before the on-stage cancellation, while the college students were given no information.

claims.label: Host Says Parental Backlash Preceded the High School Cancellation
claims.claim: The host says she is told there was immediate parental backlash once Erika Kirk's high school appearance was announced, with expected abysmal attendance, and that Erika skipped it for that reason.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain parent and school-administration communications from the week of April 6 to April 13, 2026.

claims.claim: In the clip the host plays, JD Vance says that if someone's instinct is to go after a grieving young mother rather than 'the left-wing radicals who are assaulting Savannah' or 'the people who shot Charlie Kirk' (plural), they should stay in their lane.
